role: Offline regeneration of per-sample DFA α1 for an archived workout from its stored RR series, mirroring the live analyzer's 120 s window / 20 s cadence / artifact gate, and mapping readings back onto WorkoutSamples.

flags.text: No test in EmuquTests references WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer; its only caller is the post-summary 'Re-analyze α1' path (FitnessPostSummaryView+Cards.swift:859/863), which overwrites archived α1 samples.

units.does: Re-stamps the session's RR points on the gap-corrected timeline and sweeps a windowSec (120 s) window every cadenceSec (20 s) from t = windowSec to session duration, fitting α1 on each window; returns the readings that passed the fit gates.

branches.cond: no RR series or fewer than minBeatsForFit (64) points

branches.effect: duration = last gap-corrected t_ms / 1000 (0 if timeline empty)
fit one window per cadence tick
append it; else the window is skipped

flags.text: Readings are stamped on the RR beat timeline including paused stretches (beats keep streaming while paused; gap correction only adds dropout time), but WorkoutSample.offsetSec is active elapsed seconds that stop during a pause (Ticker increments elapsedSeconds only when not paused and skips sample capture while paused). The pause timeline is not persisted, so for any workout with a pause applyReadings writes each reading onto samples shifted later by the cumulative pause length and overwrites the archived alpha1. The header/doc claim that the gap-corrected timeline is 'the same wall-clock seconds the workout samples are stamped in' is false for paused workouts.

units.does: Maps each RR point to a copy whose t_ms is the gap-corrected wall-clock offset.

Fits α1 for one window: requires >= minBeatsForFit beats, cleans RR with LiveDFAAnalyzer.cleanRRForDFA, rejects when correctedFraction > LiveDFAAnalyzer.maxCorrectedFraction or DFA fails; returns Reading(offsetSec: Int(t), alpha1, R²).

branches.cond: corrected fraction above threshold or DFAAnalyzer.compute returns nil

units.does: For time-ordered samples, sets alpha1 to the latest reading at or before the sample if it is < cadenceSec old, else clears alpha1 to nil; returns samples unchanged when readings is empty.

branches.cond: no reading yet or latest reading >= cadenceSec older
branches.effect: sample alpha1 cleared to nil; else set to that reading's alpha1

flags.text: Assumes samples are sorted by offsetSec (forward-only cursor) and that the readings' cadence equals the cadenceSec default here; reanalyze takes its own cadenceSec parameter and the two are not linked, so a non-default cadence passed to reanalyze but not here clears or stretches alpha1 wrongly. Only caller uses both defaults.
